contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Constantius II (323-361), possibly Trier mint, Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful head right. Obverse inscription: [--]TAN[-]IV[--]. Reverse description: two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCIT]VS. In exergue: [-]T[-]. Diameter: 15.3mm,…
